request.description: Cozy whimsical fantasy inn game, crisp hand-placed-looking pixel art, readable chunky shapes, limited muted moss green and warm brown palette, restrained shading, no text, no interface, no blur. Full-body sprite of a weary young adult traveler in an evergreen hooded rain cape and dark trousers, with a small tan leather backpack worn on their back and russet boots. Hood stays up and has a pale moss rim. Slightly squat storybook RPG proportions, hands relaxed at sides. Simple color clusters, toned-down highlights. This is the same person seen from four directions. Isolated figure with clear shoes and silhouette.
